HOME SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)

   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)

   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen

   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
